texto.@es: **Bir kilo elma** = un kilo de manzanas; el sustantivo permanece singular después de la cantidad.
texto.@en: **Bir kilo elma** = one kilo of apples; the noun remains singular after the amount.

texto.@en: **Yarım kilo** means half a kilo and **kaç lira?** asks how many lire costs.
